snippet.title: Skate Mate - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist today!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/45...

Test your patience (and your friendships) by skating through a seemingly endless obstacle course where you only have control over one skate. Teamwork and communication are the only way through!

Grab a friend or ride solo down a devastatingly difficult obstacle course. You will get crushed, sliced, fall, trip, and run into the occasional cactus as your teamwork is put to the ultimate test. Each player controls a skate, and through teamwork and persistence, it’s your job to safely guide your protagonists through each biome to safety.
